mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 4.0% and remains below that level for at least 2 months, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces the risk-free rate, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in employment over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp and PAYEMS increases > 10 in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases by >0.1pp and PAYEMS increases by >10 in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase following a financial crisis, a sustained increase in retail sales above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average during a post-shock recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index indicates inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains above that level for at least 3 months, it signals a deepening labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and an increase in retail sales over the past month indicates a shift in consumer spending patterns from housing to other sectors, stabilizing corporate revenue streams and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST decreases by >5% and RSAFS increases by >0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown, a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: manufacturing slowdown with labor market contraction
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.
